summary: Stairway lookout on the Nett Lake Indian Reservation, Koochiching County, MN; register gives no build date or height; standing; NHLR-registered 2021; no staffing or fire records found.

events.note: Registered January 8, 2021; nominated by Jacob Hufnagle

evidence.supports: stairway tower, one of three on the Nett Lake reservation
evidence.quote: This stairway tower is one of three towers in the Nett Lake Indian Reservation.

evidence.supports: Nett Lake visible from the tower
evidence.quote: Nett Lake is visible from this tower.

evidence.supports: Gheen Hill visible about 14.2 miles SE with binoculars
evidence.quote: Gheen Hill, where another lookout stands is visible from this tower 14.2 miles to the SE with the help of binoculars.

evidence.supports: administered by the Bois Forte Band of Chippewa

evidence.quote: Heritage Koochiching 48.06360 -93.10970 Tower Standing NHLR US 1485, MN 20

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR page and the FFLA list support facts here. No build year, builder, height, staffing or fire record was found. A search returned a different 'Heritage Lookout Tower' in Orr, MN (chamber of commerce listing); it is not this tower. A statewide A-Z list has a Heritage row naming the Band as owner, with no date or height, so it is not cited. The same list mentions a state tower 'located near Bois Forte IR' on a 1941 map at about 48.065, -93.032, roughly 6 km east of this site; the sources do not say whether it relates to any of the three towers, so it is left out.
